description: Spill volumes and durations, south-east interceptor works, Nov. 2015 (archives) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. During the month of November 2015, the City of Montreal carried out major maintenance work on the south-east interceptor, which required the latter to be put out of work. The result was a wastewater discharge whose duration and volume were estimated. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Spill, Water, River, St. Lawrence River, Interceptor. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, HTML, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-05-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
